data.name: Japan CDR Coalition
data.description: The Japan CDR Coalition (J-CDR) is a multi-stakeholder platform launched in September 2025 by Mitsubishi Research Institute and Mitsubishi Corporation, operating under MRI's Initiative for Co-creating the Future (ICF). It convenes developers, buyers, government and academia to advance CDR policy, research, training and market development in Japan. Core supporters include MOL, Sumitomo Corporation, Tokio Marine & Nichido and NYK Line.
